notes.title: Last Update for Demo
notes.content:
[i][b]We are happy to present you the latest update for the demo version, where a lot of things have been improved![/b][/i]

List of changes
-Now you can enable console in main config
-LevelLightLayer option has been added in the game settings, which optimizes dynamic light, increasing fps
-Alex now holds glowsticks and flashlight without using magic
[b]-Robot grab mechanic was changed[/b]
-QTE have been improved
-Optimization of some things
-The game has become more scary
-Improved sanity mechanic, more hallucinations
-Unnecessary files have been removed from the game
-Subtitles no longer appear in each other
-Alex's height has become slightly higher
-Reworked Key Bindings system, written from scratch, now there is a config with key assignments that you can change.
Appropriate commands added for console - bind [key] [command], unbind [type] [command]

That's all. Now I'm going to make a full game

[b][strike]Robotization.[/strike][/b]

notes.title: Demo version update | build 02022023
notes.content:
[b]build 02022023 | Demo 1.2.12[/b]

I looked at how people play my game, and I found errors, so I decided to make this small update.

[b]List of changes[/b]
-After dying from a mutant in the main part of the building, he will no longer spawn.
-In the animation of death from a mutant, the flashlight is now turned off
-Flashlight is now recharged not only by 50%.
-The battery capacity of the flashlight is slightly increased.
-A little more batteries have been added to the main part of the building.
-Added a new examine hint.
-Fixed a bug when pressing Esc did not close the journal as it should.
-Now the robot goes into a rage a little faster.
-Added a hint in the form of a light in the main part of the building, where the key item is located.
